hero.body: Stress Index measures the autonomic nervous system in 10 minutes and hands you 4 indices ready to use in the session. No more eyeballing. No more explaining without data.

problem.titleLead: You already know stress changes everything.
problem.titleEm: But can you actually measure it?
problem.body: Every day you work with people who sleep badly, recover slowly, get injured at the same time of year, and do not respond to the program the way they should. You know the nervous system is behind it. But you have no number to show.

cards.title: I rely on my experience
cards.body: It works. Until the client asks why they are not improving, or a colleague hands them a report backed by data. A gut feeling cannot be defended. Numbers can.

cards.title: HRV tools already exist
cards.body: They do. They are built for researchers, cost thousands of euros, produce reports nobody understands and take weeks to learn. They were never designed for your practice.

cards.title: I show clients their progress
cards.body: How? In words? Your client wants to see their own chart improving over time. They want a PDF to show their doctor. They want to understand why they feel different today than three weeks ago.

solution.body: Stress Index processes 24 HRV parameters and turns them into 4 indices on a 0-100 scale. You read them in a second. Your client understands them without a lecture.

features.title: Stress Index
features.body: You know exactly how much the sympathetic system is dominating. Step in before the client hits the wall, not after.

features.title: Recovery Index
features.body: Stop guessing whether they are ready for a heavier load. The number tells you when to push and when to hold back.

features.title: Balance Index
features.body: The signature of the autonomic nervous system. At a glance you see whether the sympathetic-parasympathetic balance is where it should be.

features.title: Energy Index
features.body: Real reserves, not perceived ones. Essential if you work on burnout, athletic performance or energy management.

adaptation.label: Adaptation
adaptation.text: Recovery and adaptation capacity within range for the demographic group. Weekly monitoring recommended.

steps.title: Connect the strap
steps.body: Any Bluetooth heart rate strap. The Polar H10 is the benchmark for ECG quality, but many other sensors work too. One minute and you are ready.

steps.title: Measure in 10 minutes
steps.body: Your client sits down, you start the measurement. Stress Index reads the signal in real time and filters artifacts automatically. Zero setup.

steps.title: Share the report
steps.body: A professional PDF with the 4 indices, the HRV charts and the autonomic nervous system analysis. Send it to the client with one tap. Print it. File it in the CRM.

items.title: Works on everything
items.body: Android, iOS, tablet, smartphone. Bluetooth 4.0 or later. Take it to the practice, the gym, the field. No proprietary hardware to buy.

items.title: Your clients, organized
items.body: Built-in CRM with client profiles, measurement history and session-to-session comparison. See the trend over time and adjust the program with data in hand.

items.title: Privacy guaranteed by law
items.body: Servers in Germany, GDPR compliant, client consent recorded automatically. Data never leaves Europe. Ever.

items.title: Serious science, plain language
items.body: 24 HRV parameters grounded in the international literature, demographic normalization by age and sex. The scientific rigor you expect, without the complexity you do not need.
